items.title: The receipt-schema dependency extension (BL-003/ADV-005) is now the last schema-layer blocker in the program
items.hypothesis: With the preregistration schema repaired, the only remaining structural blocker is the knowledge-transaction receipt schema's inability to represent shared upstream dependency between roots -- the entire subject of KL-006 and the core structure of KL-008, and RESEARCH-METHOD's mandatory shared-dependency control (only the copied half is testable today, C07).
items.discriminatingTest: Two roots declared with a dependency edge must not yield margin 2 (BL-003's original test). Any change reopens KL-000: the evaluator hash unfreezes, every digest moves, and the full re-registration discipline (exact-equality where nothing should move, inversion ablations for every new rule, I12 extension for any new receipt field) applies.
items.whyItMatters: KL-006 and KL-008 cannot register meaningful protocols without it; their new v0.2 preregistrations say so in their kernelSpecificConstraint fields. It is the single most consequential remaining design decision and it is digest-moving, so it belongs in one deliberately versioned change (with the margin-rename bundle BL-026, or alone) -- never mixed into a nothing-moves registration.
items.cost: evaluator change + protocol v2.x + full KL-000 re-registration and re-run + both-implementation coordination; the largest single item in the program
items.prerequisitesNote: owner decision on scope (which of BL-003/BL-026/F4-empty-ledger travel together); the v1.3.0 disciplines make it executable safely

items.title: Verification commands gate on their own exit status (VER-102 mechanization)
items.hypothesis: A close-procedure script (or documented invocation set) that runs the suite with pipefail and refuses to reach git commit on nonzero exit removes the class that put commit 6e286b9 on a red suite.
items.discriminatingTest: A deliberately failing test inserted in a scratch branch cannot be committed past the procedure.
items.whyItMatters: The suite fired and the pipeline muzzled it. Enforcement that can be silently bypassed by wiring is PKT-101 one layer down.
items.cost: one small script or a documented two-command discipline; this run already practises the discipline manually

items.title: Registration scheduling for the eleven now-schema-ready kernels, and the A2 decision that gates KL-011's semantics
items.hypothesis: None -- a queue, owner's to order. Each kernel's own preregistration now states, as reasons rather than nulls, exactly what its registration must supply; KL-001's real first gate (BL-031/BL-032 inside it) and KL-011's v0.2 registration are the two with the most groundwork done. A2 (19,152 worlds) is the one open decision that any KL-011 registration would transport.
items.discriminatingTest: A kernel registers: its preregistration's unanswered fields become answers, its protocol freezes, its sidecar binds, and the conformance test keeps passing on the populated document.
items.whyItMatters: The program's next scientific step is now purely a scheduling decision; nothing structural stands in front of nine of eleven kernels (KL-006/KL-008 wait on BL-037).
items.cost: per kernel, as costed in each STATUS
items.safety: per-kernel boundaries now recorded in each preregistration
